properties.name: manhattan_1660
properties.map: Afbeeldinge van de Stadt Amsterdam in Nieuw Neederlandt (the Castello Plan), after Jacques Cortelyou's survey of 1660; copy of c. 1665-70 in the Biblioteca Medicea Laurenziana, Florence (NYPL photograph, Stokes 1660-B-42A)
properties.georeferencing: 13 control points picked here on the plan against today's street intersections (tools/gcps_own.json, castello1660), thin-plate spline; the plan is a bird's-eye drawing, not a survey to scale
properties.note: The whole town below the wall: Wall St (the palisade), Pearl St (the East River shore of 1660: the houses stood on its landward side), State St (the shore behind the fort), Broadway. Includes Fort Amsterdam (today's Custom House block). West of Broadway the plan shows gardens, the Company's garden and the burial ground down to the Hudson shore (about Greenwich St / Trinity Place) with houses only along Broadway: ring broadway_west is that frontage (35 m deep, Beaver St to Morris St; the row thins out north of it and is left out). Block interiors east of Broadway are gardens and orchards on the plan; about 340 houses stood in the town.
properties.method: edges set on today's streets after reading the warped plan: every block inside these edges carries houses on the plan
